findings.detail: pd.get_dummies produces dimension mismatch on unseen categories in inference data.
OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False) creates dense array. If cardinality is high (e.g. 10k), creates 10k dense columns leading to multi-gigabyte RAM explosion and OOM/timeouts.
